create_version_object: create a Version object from a package name, version string, or packaging version object
compare_version_lt: compare two Version objects using less than to check if one version is older
compare_version_gt: compare two Version objects using greater than to check if one version is newer
compare_version_eq: compare two Version objects using equality to check if versions are the same
parse_version_from_package: parse a version from a package name like statsmodels or sklearn using the Version constructor
